query: A finite uniform product distribution of independent bounded random variables has lower tail probability at most variance divided by the square of the deviation, Chebyshev inequality.

items.informal_description: For a finite measure space $(\Omega, \mu)$ and a square-integrable real-valued random variable $X : \Omega \to \mathbb{R}$, the measure of the set where $|X(\omega) - \mathbb{E}[X]| \geq c$ is bounded above by $\frac{\operatorname{Var}(X)}{c^2}$ for any $c > 0$. Formally, $\mu\left(\{\omega \mid |X(\omega) - \mathbb{E}[X]| \geq c\}\right) \leq \frac{\operatorname{Var}(X)}{c^2}$.

items.name: ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun.variance_add
items.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {X Y : Ω → ℝ},
  MeasureTheory.MemLp X 2 μ →
    MeasureTheory.MemLp Y 2 μ →
      ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun X Y μ →
        ProbabilityTheory.variance (X + Y) μ = ProbabilityTheory.variance X μ + ProbabilityTheory.variance Y μ

items.name: ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun.variance_sum
items.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {ι : Type u_3} {X : ι → Ω → ℝ} {s : Finset ι},
  (∀ i ∈ s, MeasureTheory.MemLp (X i) 2 μ) →
    ((↑s).Pairwise fun i j => ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun (X i) (X j) μ) →
      ProbabilityTheory.variance (∑ i ∈ s, X i) μ = ∑ i ∈ s, ProbabilityTheory.variance (X i) μ

items.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {X Y : Ω → ℝ},
  MeasureTheory.MemLp X 2 μ →
    MeasureTheory.MemLp Y 2 μ →
      ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun X Y μ →
        ProbabilityTheory.variance (fun ω => X ω + Y ω) μ =
          ProbabilityTheory.variance X μ + ProbabilityTheory.variance Y μ
